_readme: Deeds copy (Saga), v1, for docs/design/achievements-difficulty-traits-v0.1.md at 9def719 (v0.1.3c, ANNA-APPROVED except the §3.2 trait list). Names, locked hints and earned flavour for every §1.5 deed id (34: 18 visible, 9 hidden, 7 hard), with §1.6 trigger clarifications folded in, plus Deeds-screen and creator-picker chrome (Director's Body / Mind / Social / Lineage tabs and the flaw-vs-strength tally). Voice: narrator-voice-v1.md. No digits or number words in prose (the counter may use {earned} / {total}); exact counts stay in the §1.5 table only. No iron or metal or spear, no modern or game words in deed lines, no saber colour, no he/she/him/her and no singular they for any cat, no gendered words (including king and grandsire). Hidden deeds show lockedName ??? and a vague lockedHint until earned, then name and flavour. Flavour is one sentence, second person, past tense. Locked hints for visible and hard deeds say what to do, in words, without counts. Built by build_deeds_copy.py, checked by validate_deeds_copy.py. Draft until Anna signs the names off through Director. Nothing here is committed.

_source.sections: §1.2–1.5 (deeds), §1.6 (trigger clarifications), §2.5 (difficulty flavour), §3.1–3.2 and Director's creator-tab ruling (Body, Mind, Social, Lineage; flaws-against-strengths tally)
_source.epithets: hyena_bane name follows reputation-copy-v1.json epithet Hyena-Bane; oathbreaker follows Honour's L3 name Oathbreaker

_tokens.earned: How many deeds this profile has earned. Only in screen.counter.
_tokens.total: How many deeds there are in all (34). Only in screen.counter.

_schema.deeds: Keyed by spec id. kind = visible | hidden | hard, taken from the §1.5 table. name = player-facing name, shown on earned tiles and on locked visible or hard tiles. renamedFrom = Tundra's working title where Saga renamed it. lockedName = ??? for hidden, else the same as name. lockedHint = a plain line on a locked tile (vague for hidden). flavour = one earned sentence, second person, past tense.
_schema.screen: Deeds-screen chrome, plus traitTabs (Body, Mind, Social, Lineage) and tallyLabel, which the creator picker also uses.
_schema.creator: The rest of the creator-picker chrome, including final §2.5 difficulty flavour. Trait names, hints and flavour stay in traits-copy-v1.json.

screen.title: Deeds
screen.persistenceNote: Deeds stay with you, even if a save is gone.
screen.header: Deeds stay with you, even if a save is gone. A sandbox run earns none.
screen.challengeNote: Challenges need Standard or harsher, and permadeath or heir.
screen.rumourNote: On a cat you have met, traits show as confirmed. On a cat you have only heard of, traits show as rumours, and a wrong rumour is struck through.

creator.pageLede: Choose how hard the Vale will be, then take flaws to cover strengths.

difficulty.gentle: The ice has stepped back, and the herds are thick.
difficulty.harsh: A long winter. The herds run thin.
difficulty.ice_age: The ice comes south, and only the hard survive. A rival stays as hungry as you are, but packs, clans and lions grow bolder.

creator.tallyCovered: Your flaws cover your strengths. Nothing is left over.
creator.tallyShort: Your flaws do not yet cover your strengths.
creator.tallyOver: Your flaws more than cover your strengths. The rest will be lost.
creator.tallyEmpty: You have taken no strengths and no flaws.
creator.fightLimit: You already carry as many fight strengths as you may. No more may be added.
creator.lookMarkLegend: A gold mark means this also touches how you look.
creator.playOnlyLegend: Some natures can only be earned in play, and cannot be chosen here.
creator.portraitWins: The portrait always wins: coat, markings and eye colour come from the look you chose, not from this telling.
